sources.title: Supertonic 3 — Lightning-Fast, On-Device, Multilingual TTS
sources.snippet: Supertonic 3 is a 99M-parameter open-weight text-to-speech model from Supertone. Runs on CPU via ONNX Runtime. No GPU. No cloud. No API. 31 languages.

sources.title: Supertonic 3 — Models — The AI Bench
sources.snippet: Supertonic 3 expands the open-weight release from 5 to 31 languages, improves reading stability, and cuts repeat/skip failures. `pip install supertonic` and synthesize immediately with selectable voice styles.

sources.snippet: For a managed creation workflow, Supertonic 3 is now officially available in Supertone Play and the Supertone API. Use them when you want hosted content creation tools, diverse commercially usable preset voices, zero-shot voice cloning, or API-based integration without managing local model files.
